runs.summary: The deployed dashboard reads as a heavily formatted default Power BI report rather than a bespoke executive product. Oversized green framing, empty header space, basic KPI tiles, weak typography, cramped chart labels, inconsistent spacing, visible scrollbars, and the trial banner substantially reduce polish. It has a recognizable grid and reasonably consistent chart colouring, but it falls well short of the reference's refined hierarchy, restrained palette, coherent surfaces, and presentation-ready finish.

The deployed dashboard looks unfinished and substantially below the reference standard. The trial banner, empty header area, oversized green framing, missing KPI labels, severe clipping, visible scrollbars, cramped charts, and inconsistent spacing undermine executive credibility. Although the white panels and recurring green accent provide some consistency, the presentation remains much closer to a roughly formatted default report than a premium bespoke dashboard.

The deployed dashboard looks unfinished and strongly template-driven. Harsh green framing, heavy borders, an empty header area, weak KPI labeling, cramped chart typography, inconsistent spacing, visible scrolling, and the trial banner substantially undermine polish and executive credibility. It lacks the reference's restrained palette, refined surfaces, clear hierarchy, and cohesive premium composition.
